proofAssessment.assessment: Each nonempty disjoint subset-mean equality is broken by changing a coordinate on one side. Finite open-dense intersection proves density and generic existence, including empty dimension.

Nodup words identify genuine label sets. Nonempty contiguous block and nonempty complement cannot share the full mean. Centered prefix injectivity on Fin(length) excludes the duplicated endpoint; rotating the unique maximum proves existence and uniqueness.

The unique best nonempty prefix mean gives a strict chord first face. The remainder has strictly smaller prefix means. Length induction constructs faces; first-face characterization and structural induction prove full uniqueness.

For descending chord blocks, every prefix is bounded by the sum of positive block totals and an actual prefix attains it. Actual ofFn prefix and tail coordinate identities translate this to the existing maxima. Face deletion preserves order and yields the exact cut equation.

markedSplit uses one-based markers with g<q<=d, retaining the endpoint. permOfWord proves actual label bijectivity. markedForward rotates after the marker and moves the selected face first, with exact length, word and maximum specifications.

For any output, rotate its nonempty head uniquely below the chord, insert it among the remainder faces by unequal slopes, and recover t=k-r and q=length(A)+t. The resulting forward word/marker are proved equal to the output. Chosen preimage is a right inverse; finite surjectivity implies injectivity and the left inverse.

The actual marked equivalence reindexes the finite sum; exponent addition factors the weights for any real L. Both sides are continuous finite sums. The closed equality set contains the proved dense generic set, giving the all-real identity without a generic or probabilistic premise.
